In order to earn a living, he finds himself in a psychiatric hospital, pretending to be mentally ill. credits.title: Numbers
credits.overview: Ten figures walk around in a circle. All they have is a number. The “Great Zero” monitors them. Based on a dystopian parable by Oleg Sentsov, this film was created between Kyiv and the Siberian penal colony where Sentsov spent five years as a political prisoner.
